title: ADR-0155 step 2 (engine): the fixed-read leaf seam — door admission, position, verb and recipient rules, the two recognised classes, descent into composed scopes, and the driver declaration `fixedReadLeaves`
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvvVzM5KhCWkT5f45c

Filing gate: ④ an execution card of an accepted cross-layer ADR · Source: fleet (ADR-0155, accepted in PR #34735, merge 64ccf6b0, ruling 6942854600; its Execution plan says the seats cut the cards in order). Part of #33787. Step 1 (#35571) merged as c99156ee0c (2026-11-20, 07:51 UTC); its close-out 7033733046 lists the carry-forwards below.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：一个成员在同一对象上被共享超过 5000 条后，多出来的共享静默失效（#33787）。ADR-0155 分 6 步修，第 1 步（spec 契约）已合并，这是第 2 步。
- 这一步做什么：让引擎认得并安全地传递第 1 步定义的"共享子查询叶子"：哪里能放、哪个动作能用、为谁读，放错一律拒绝；驱动通过一个新声明说明自己能不能执行它。还没有任何地方真正生成这个叶子，用户可见行为不变。
- 不做会怎样：后面的驱动编译（第 3、4 步）和 plugin-sharing 切换（第 6 步）都无处接入，#33787 修不了。
- 要你做的：无。

## Why (business)
Inherits #33787: customers with large sharing volumes silently lose access past 5,000 grants per member per object. ADR-0155 is the accepted fix. This card is its engine step, the seam every driver step and the plugin-sharing switch go through.

## Scope (ADR-0155 Execution plan, step 2)
- Door admission and pass-through of the fixed-read leaves step 1 added (`admitFixedReadLeaves` gets its first callers).
- The position rule, and the verb rule (③ ruled A): the write form is admitted only in the `where` of a predicate `update`. On a read verb it is refused like any misplaced leaf.
- The recipient rule, pinned on its four cases: the context's user, its delegator, a system context, and any other recipient (refused).
- The two recognised classes (② as ruled: R2 with R1 behind it for an object on another datasource, R1 for the host class); the descent into composed scopes; the refusal.
- The driver declaration R2 reads: **`DriverCapabilities.fixedReadLeaves`**, a list of the fixed-read leaf brand names the driver evaluates, absence = none. One key covers both leaves, mirroring the door's `admitFixedReadLeaves`; it is declared here beside its reader (ADR-0078). The name was ruled by the seat under ADR-0155 O1 and recorded on #35571. The card says how it relates to the existing boolean `readableIdsLeaf` (`packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts`), so that two capability spellings do not drift.
- Carry-forwards from step 1's review:
  - `packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts#resolveFilterTokens` keeps a fixed-read leaf by reference (`isFixedReadLeaf`). Today only `ReadableIds` survives a token rebuild, so a scope carrying a token beside the leaf arrives unbranded and is refused with 400. `@objectstack/core` is not in the ADR's consumer list; the card names it.
  - Seam cases for the write form on a read verb (refused) and for the leaf outside the `$in` comparand (L2 N3).
- The cases of ADR-0147's anchor are pinned on the card that adds that leaf to the seam (plan step 2, last sentence), not here unless this card adds it.
- ⛔ No boot refusal on this card (plan step 5: "No card up to here refuses a boot"). ⛔ No producer writes the leaf yet (that is step 6).
- The card declares its own `Clause-②:` and runs its own gates. Governing text: `docs/adr/0155-sharing-scope-share-grants-lower-to-an-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf.md` (D1–D6, Execution plan step 2).

## Order
Step 2 of 6. After it merges, the seat cuts 3 (driver-sql + Turso remote; also carries L2 N4, the per-dialect witnesses for the empty-id guard and the cross-organization nested case), 4 (driver-memory) and 5 (the rest of the census; also settles whether `service-analytics/src/read-scope-sql.ts#compileScopedFilterToSql` is one of D4's two brand-naming callers). Step 6 is #33787 itself and lands last.

## Reader
Seat `repo:objectstack#7`, a dedicated card thread (L program; area-lease 〈不入区〉). L1 by `L1-a`; contract (L2) review per `contract-review.md`.

## Dedupe
`"ADR-0155" is:issue` → #33787 (the defect), #35571 (step 1, closed), #33877 (on hold), #33899 and #34102 (closed). No step-2 card exists.

Grade: p2, the grade of the card it unblocks (#33787, p2). Type: Task.
